name: Secret
overview: Scripture reveals that certain things remain secret and belong solely to the Lord, as stated in Deuteronomy 29:29, emphasizing God's sovereign knowledge beyond human understanding. The Lord discerns the heart rather than outward appearances (1 Samuel 16:7) and intimately knows His servants and their actions (2 Samuel 7:20; 2 Kings 19:27). Those who fear the Lord are granted insight into His covenant, receiving divine secrets for their instruction and guidance (Psalms 25:14). Thus, the biblical perspective on secrets highlights God's exclusive knowledge and the faithful's privileged access to His revealed will.
